definitions.explanation: A country that belongs to an international organization, treaty, or alliance. Frequently used in the context of the United Nations, EU, and other international bodies.

examples.japanese: EU{加盟国|かめいこく}は{二十七|にじゅうなな}か{国|こく}ある。
{新|あら}たな{加盟国|かめいこく}を{迎|むか}えた。
examples.english: A new member state was welcomed.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}{加盟国|かめいこく}の{代表|だいひょう}が{総会|そうかい}に{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Representatives from UN member states gathered at the general assembly.

notes: Composed of {加盟|かめい} (joining, affiliation) + {国|こく} (country). Common collocations: {加盟国|かめいこく}を{増|ふ}やす (to increase member states), {加盟国|かめいこく}の{義務|ぎむ} (obligations of member states). Often preceded by the organization name: {国連|こくれん}{加盟国|かめいこく} (UN member state), EU{加盟国|かめいこく} (EU member state), NATO{加盟国|かめいこく} (NATO member state). Compare with {加盟|かめい}する (to join/become a member).
